subject: alt-ft
title: ALT.FT.------POL.DY.
description: Diagram opening MP(I)-9 — the section connecting alternative-creativity to political-consciousness in the sixties. The prose below the diagram identifies what the crossing diagrams: 'there was, of course, a relationship between alternative creativity and the emergence of political consciousness in the sixties. For the realness of this period in time would establish a particular vibrational state that permeated the composite spectrum of "doing."' The crossing diagrams that relationship structurally: ALT-FT (alternative functionalism — the form's actual working) is crossed with POL-DY (political dynamics — the actual political-working the form gets crossed with). ALT-FT sits on the left with the subject-arrow; ACT (activism) branches upward from the main line, DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture's center) and UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)) branch from ACT, and ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism) branches from UNF-PI. INFO-TRNS (information transference) descends from the main line; RT-ALGN (reality alignment) branches left from INFO-TRNS, SOC-RT-INT (social reality interpretation) descends from RT-ALGN, and DEF (definition) branches from SOC-RT-INT. POL-DY sits at the lower-right end of the main line as the partner; LK-IMP (linkage implications) descends from the main line near POL-DY, and TRS (transition) branches from LK-IMP.
